return_reason: Customer returned the sealed unit within 48 hours.
justification: Sealed retail box returned within 48 hours, and the serial matches the original sale. Grade A with strong demand, so restock at full price.

return_reason: The unit won't hold a charge past an hour.
justification: Customer says the unit won't hold a charge past an hour. A new battery costs less than a third of the resale value, so refurbish after wiping the stored data.

return_reason: The screen works intermittently.
justification: Intermittent screen issue makes direct restock unsuitable, but the item retains sufficient recovery value for refurbishment. Data wipe must be completed before resale.

return_reason: No reason recorded; the item works fully but was returned without its box.
justification: Works fully but the box is gone. Open-box resale recovers most of the value, and it can't be restocked as new without packaging.

return_reason: No reason recorded; the unit works but is a last-generation model.
justification: Last-generation model with weak demand. Refurbishing would cost more than it earns, but the unit works, so donate it after a data wipe.

return_reason: The back panel is bulging and the unit is warm to the touch.
justification: Back panel is bulging and the unit is warm to the touch. Isolate it, do not ship it, and send it to certified battery recycling.

return_reason: The customer reported a swollen battery.
justification: Note reports a swollen battery. Item must not be resold or shipped as-is; route to certified battery recycling with hazmat handling.

return_reason: The screen flickers sometimes.
justification: Note says the screen flickers sometimes. That could be a loose cable (cheap) or a failing panel (costly). Refurbish is likely best, but test the unit before committing to a repair.

return_reason: The customer changed their mind.
justification: Customer changed their mind. The item is unused and has all its accessories. Grade A with steady demand.

return_reason: The note is ambiguous about whether the fault is cosmetic or functional.
justification: Condition grade is B but the note is ambiguous about whether the fault is cosmetic or functional. Resale as open-box has the highest recovery if the unit powers on reliably; inspect before approving.

return_reason: The condition note is blank and the photo shows a scratch across the lens.
justification: Condition note is blank and the photo shows a scratch across the lens. Resale at a B-grade price looks like the best fit, but a hands-on check would confirm it.

return_reason: The water damage indicator is tripped and the board is corroded.
justification: Water damage indicator is tripped and the board is corroded. Repair costs more than any resale value, so recycle it for materials.

return_reason: The screen is cracked.
justification: Cracked screen only. The rest of the unit tests fine, a new panel is cheap next to the resale price, and demand for this model is high.

return_reason: No reason recorded; the tablet is older with a worn but working display.
justification: Older tablet with a worn but working display. Resale demand is unclear, so donation is the safe default. Confirm it powers on first.

return_reason: No reason recorded; the item has minor cosmetic wear and is fully functional.
justification: Minor cosmetic wear on the casing and fully functional. It sells well as a used-grade item without any repair.

return_reason: No reason recorded; the item was returned unopened with its seal intact.
justification: Unopened, original seal intact, grade A. High current demand supports restocking at full price.

return_reason: The return was a shipping mix-up.
justification: Unopened and still sealed; the return was a shipping mix-up. This is the highest-demand SKU this week, so restock right away.

return_reason: A leaking coin cell was found when the case was opened.
justification: A leaking coin cell was found when the case was opened. Handle it with gloves and send it to hazardous-waste recycling.

return_reason: No reason recorded; the older model is fully functional.
justification: Older model with low resale demand and refurbishment cost close to resale value. Fully functional, so donation (after data wipe) avoids disposal and earns a tax credit.

return_reason: The speaker distorts at high volume.
justification: Speaker distorts at high volume. Swapping the speaker module is quick, and the unit still resells well afterwards.

return_reason: No reason recorded; the item is in excellent condition with its charger but no retail box.
justification: Excellent condition with the charger, but no retail box. Open-box resale keeps most of the value.

return_reason: No reason recorded; the item works fine but is discontinued.
justification: Works fine but is discontinued, and the market price is below the handling cost. Donate it to a partner charity.

return_reason: The customer says it shuts off randomly.
justification: Customer says it shuts off randomly. The cause could be firmware, the battery or the board. Refurbish has the best expected return, but the agent isn't sure of the cause.

return_reason: The battery pack is visibly swollen and has pushed the case apart.
justification: Battery pack is visibly swollen and has pushed the case apart. Quarantine it and recycle it through the battery stream only.

return_reason: The item was returned unused within the return window.
justification: Returned unused within the window. The seal is broken but all parts are present. Restock after a quick visual check.
